title: Create a new Python project with uv
summary: Use `uv init` to set up a new Python project structure in your current folder or a specific directory. This creates the necessary configuration files like `pyproject.toml`.

steps.explain: Run this command in the folder where you want to create the project. It initializes the project structure.
Alternatively, specify a path to create the project in a new or existing directory.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the directory where the project should be created.
